English:
Heya, <Suzu>. Do
you know why the sky's blue...?

Ah, sure. When light passes
through moisture in the atmosphere,

it causes the warm color
hues to ebb. Because of this--
Whoa whoa whoa! How do you know all that?

I don't think being a ninja
has anything to do with it...
Oh, no, it's all good; I've heard enough.
